name: VIGIL — external privileged login to payment activity
description: Correlates an external privileged login, outbound network connection and anomalous UPI API activity on the same host within twenty minutes.
query:
sequence by host.name, user.name with maxspan=20m
  [authentication where event.action == "login" and event.outcome == "success" and vigil.security.source_zone == "external"]
  [network where event.action == "connection" and destination.ip != null]
  [web where event.action == "upi_transfer" and vigil.transaction.profile == "outside_normal_batch"]
